mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_outbox ( event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSON) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_outbox WHERE ( status = 'NEW' AND ( next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW(3) ) ) OR ( status = 'PUBLISHING' AND locked_until <= NOW(3) ) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE task_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHING', claim_token = #{token}, locked_until = DATE_ADD( NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND ) WHERE id = #{id} AND ( ( status = 'NEW' AND ( next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW(3) ) ) OR ( status = 'PUBLISHING' AND locked_until <= NOW(3) ) )
UPDATE task_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = NOW(3), claim_token = NULL, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHING' AND claim_token = #{token}

UPDATE task_outbox SET status = 'NEW', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD( NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND ), claim_token = NULL, locked_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHING' AND claim_token = #{token}
